camera.easing: ease-in over f30-36, linear, ease-out over f76-79
camera.notes: starts with the first turn; peak under the 0.15 m/s cap

ren.breath: in time with the crank from f30: in on the up half-turn, out on the down half-turn; shoulders rise and fall 1 cm
ren.crank_clamp: crank clamp (all keys from f12): brick lying across between the inner faces of his knees at their tops, long axis left-right, port end toward the near (left) knee, pivot end to his right; body centre about z 0.64, top face about z 0.66 (4 cm above the 0.62 m knee tops) and tipped about 30 deg toward the lens (front-left), so from the lens the top face and the pip sit above the near knee's silhouette, never behind it
ren.eyeline: the port and the arm f0-39, the phone from f40
ren.face: focused calm: brows level, eyes on the crank, then on the phone from f40; no comic expression

keys.pose: crank in both hands, held up between his knees at knee-top height (his lap, knees up: top face and pip above the near knee from the lens), phone in the left palm under it; right hand takes the cable's source plug
lines the plug up with the crank's port (port end toward his near, left knee; hands stay at knee-top height)
pushes it in (small wrist push, f10-11)
clamps the crank between the tops of his knees (see crank_clamp: top face and pip above the near knee); right thumb lifts the folded knob out of its groove (f12-15)
slight stiffness: a 2-frame hold (the hinge has never been used)
swings the arm out on its pivot (ease-out, f17-22), clean stop, no bounce; the brick does not sink in the clamp
right hand grips the knob; left hand lifts the phone to about z 0.76 over the near knee, left of the port end (see phone_hold); breath in (f22-29)
first turn: handle leaves the top (12 o'clock), ease-in over the first half-turn; first revolution completes at f56 (26 f)
eyes move from the crank to the phone as its light holds steady
steady rhythm: 1 turn per second (24 frames per revolution), handle at the top at f56 and every 24 frames after
left thumb starts to type, one slow glide per word: 'Dinner' f56-63, 'at' f66-70, '8?' f73-79 (not legible at this size); the phone stays in its place beside the crank while he types

locomotion.note: seated on the kerb, knees up

ren.phone_hold: phone (all keys from f22): left hand holds it at about z 0.74-0.78 over the near (left) knee, just left of the crank's port end, screen tipped up toward his face; never between the lens and the crank body or pip
secondary: right elbow and shoulder follow the knob's 0.17 m circle; the torso stays quiet; the knob may dip behind the far (right) knee at the bottom of its circle, the pip never does
cable: short posed loop from the port over his left knee to the phone; 2 mm of sway per turn (keyed, no simulation)

animation.preview_frame_reason: crank arm out mid-turn with the pip at full, the glow on his face steady and his eyes just moved to the phone: effort, light and face in one still, early enough that the push has not yet cropped him

props.crank_charger: clamped high between his knees from f12 (top face and pip above the near knee from the lens); arm unfolded f17-22; turning clockwise (from his view) from f30; pip brightness follows handle speed: 0 -> full over f30-38, steady from f38
props.phone_ren: 1 % flicker until the first turn: dips at f5-6, f17-19 and f26-27; steady from f30 (the glow on his face stops flickering and holds); charging bolt beside 1 % from f30 (live source while turning)

risks_m3: crank handle rotation is a single driven bone; pip emission keyed to its angular speed (driver)
crank body wedged between the knees at knee-top height: check knee-to-brick contact and that the pip clears the near-knee silhouette from the lens at f12, f46 and f79 on the proxy
animation.sound_sync: ratchet click at each handle top: f56, then every 24 frames (the phase carries on across SC04_SH060-SH090); breath in time

timing.index: 0-based; f0 is the first frame, t = f / 24

characters.action: plugs the cable into the crank's port, unfolds the arm, cranks slowly with his right hand; phone in his left
characters.facing: south (seen three-quarter from the lens, face toward screen left), eyes between the crank and the phone

composition.notes: Lens on the pavement 30 deg east of his facing (south), so he reads three-quarter facing screen left, with face, crank and phone all turned toward the lens; aim at the midpoint between his crown and the pip (about z 0.79 m), a slight tilt down. Push-in 2 of 2 from the first crank turn (about frame 30) to the end: 0.28 m straight toward him over 50 frames (0.134 m/s, under the 0.15 m/s cap). Ends as a medium close-up. Pip at 1 % of frame height or more; crank at 10 % of frame width or more, with its top and pip seen above his near (left) knee (DEPENDENCY for the animation clamp); cable's visible length short and posed over the knee. Car flank behind the jacket (the ray through the jacket top hits the car at y about -0.83). The emptied glovebox sits dark far left of frame (it must not glow). Phone-lit rule: 30 deg, inside the 45 deg limit (camera.phone_lit.framing).

background_practicals: street lamp by the shop (lights only the shop front)
lighting.hand_light: crank pip, reach 0.1 m, lit while turning
lighting.key_state: flicker until the first crank turn, then steady

rim.source: afterglow from the west (his right, screen left)
